title: Past Perfect / Pluscuamperfecto (past of the past)
bridge: A cikin Turanci, past perfect (had comido) yana nufin wata halin da ya farke wata dabara da yaushe. A cikin Hausa, muna da wani yankin da ya farke wata dabara da yaushe, amma akwai farillace masu muhimmiyar: tsarin kalma ne ya bambanta (a Turanci, 'had + participle' ya kamata a kowane wuri), da kuma a Turanci ana yin amfani da 'already', 'just', 'never' don nuna tsari na tsari. Tsammanin: a cikin Hausa, muna yin amfani da past simple (na ci) a wajen past perfect (had ci) a wajen wata dabara da yaushe, idan akwai wata dabara da yaushe. Kuma, a cikin Hausa, pluscuamperfecto ya kamata ya dace da 'had' mai canzawa, while a Turanci 'had' ya kamata ya kasance mai canzawa a kowane mutum.
rule: Past perfect ya kamata ya dace da 'had' (a kowane mutum) + participle mai canzawa na fasaha mai canzawa. Ya kamata ya yi amfani don nuna wata dabara da ya farke wata dabara da yaushe, wato 'past of the past'. A cikin jumla mai amfani: sunan + had + participle. A cikin jumla mai laifi: had not (hadn't) + participle. A cikin tambaya: Had + sunan + participle. Ya kamata ya yi amfani da 'already', 'just', 'never', 'ever', 'by the time', 'before', 'after'. Misali: 'I had finished my homework before dinner' (na ci aiki na gida kafin yin cin abinci). Kuma ya kamata ya yi amfani a cikin magana mai yawa don nuna tsari na fasaha (present perfect -> past perfect). Tsammanin: a cikin Turanci da 'after' da 'before' a wajen 'before' da 'after', a wajen 'before' da 'after', a wajen 'before' da 'after', a wajen 'before' da 'after' da 'after' da 'after'. Tsammanin: a cikin Hausa, pluscuamperfecto ya kamata ya yi amfani da 'had' mai canzawa, while a Turanci 'had' ya kamata ya kasance mai canzawa a kowane mutum.

common_error.wrong: When I arrived, she already left.
common_error.correct: When I arrived, she had already left.

common_error.explanation: A cikin Hausa, muna yin amfani da past simple (ta wuce) don wata dabara da yaushe, amma a Turanci, don nuna wata dabara da ya farke wata dabara da yaushe, ya kamata ya yi amfani da past perfect (had + participle). Tsammanin: wata dabara ta 'wuce' ya farke 'zo', saboda haka ya kamata ya yi amfani da 'had left'. Don nuna wannan, ka sanya wata dabara da yaushe a past perfect; wata dabara da yaushe a past simple.

levels.label: Sequence of events: past perfect + past simple
levels.translation: Tsari na tsari: past perfect + past simple

examples.original: After they had eaten, they went for a walk.

examples.note: 'Just' ya kamata ya kasance tsakanin 'had' da participle. Ya dace da 'acabar de' a cikin Hausa.

examples.original: I realized I had never tried sushi before that day.

examples.note: 'Never' a cikin jumla mai laifi; ya kamata ya nuna cewa wata abu ba ya farke ba.

examples.original: They had already finished the project when the boss arrived.

examples.translation: Sun gama aiki kafin shugaban ya zo.
examples.note: Da 'already', ya kamata ya nuna cewa wata dabara da yaushe ya gama.

title: Conditionals Type 1 and 2 / Masu yin wasu da yaushe
bridge: A cikin yare da yaushe, muna yin amfani da yanzu na subjuntivo a cikin wasu da yaushe, kuma muna yin amfani da wasu na yaushe da wasu na yaushe a cikin wasu da yaushe (Idan zan da lokaci, zan tafi). A cikin turanci, tsarin yana da wahala: a cikin wasu na farko muna yin amfani da yanzu na simple a cikin wasu 'if' kuma a cikin wasu na wasu da 'will' a cikin wasu na wasu. A cikin wasu na biyu, muna yin amfani da yaushe na simple a cikin wasu 'if' kuma 'would' + infinitive a cikin wasu na wasu. Yi godiya: a cikin turanci, yaushe na simple a cikin wasu na biyu ba ya nuna lokaci da yaushe ba, amma wani halin da ba a daidai ba a cikin yanzu ko a cikin wasu. kada ka yi kuskure da fasaha daga turanci, saboda tsarin suna da wahala.
rule: Wasu na farko (Type 1) yana da amfani da halaye masu daidaitawa ko masu yiwuwa a cikin yanzu ko a cikin wasu. Ana tsarawa da: Idan + mai / + da yaushe + da yaushe + da yaushe + da yaushe + da yaushe + da yaushe + da yaushe. Misali: Idan ya yi, za mu zama a gida. Wasu 'if' na iya zama a farkon ko a karshen, kuma idan yana a farkon, za a sanya shi da tsari. Za a iya yin amfani da 'unless' (ba ko) a matsayin 'if not'. Wasu na biyu (Type 2) yana da amfani da halaye masu yiwuwa, masu yiwuwa ko masu yiwuwa a cikin yanzu ko a cikin wasu. Ana tsarawa da: Idan + mai / + da yaushe + da yaushe + da yaushe + da yaushe + da yaushe. Misali: Idan na da kudi mai, zan tafi. A cikin wasu na biyu, da yaushe 'to be' yana da 'were' don dukan mutane (Idan na da kudi mai...). Ba a yi amfani da 'was' a cikin tsarin da ya dace ba, duk da haka a turanci na yaushe a wani wasu. Za a iya yin amfani da 'could' ko 'might' a matsayin 'would' don nuna yiwuwa ko iko. Wasu na biyu yana da amfani da nishadi ('Idan na da kudi mai, zan tafi...') kuma don nuna burin da ba a daidai ba.

concept_examples.text: If I study, I will pass the exam.

concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ˈstʌdi aɪ wɪl pæs ðə ɪɡˈzæm/

concept_examples.text: If she calls you, tell her I am busy.
concept_examples.translation: Idan ta kira ka, faɗa masa na da wahala.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃi kɔːlz ju tɛl hɜr aɪ æm ˈbɪzi/

concept_examples.text: If I were rich, I would buy a house.
concept_examples.translation: Idan zan da kudi mai, zan sayi gida.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜr rɪtʃ aɪ wʊd baɪ ə haʊs/

concept_examples.text: What would you do if you won the lottery?
concept_examples.translation: Me za ka yi idan ka ci nasara da wasu?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʌt wʊd ju duː ɪf ju wʌn ðə ˈlɑːtəri/

common_error.wrong: If I would have time, I will go to the party.
common_error.correct: If I have time, I will go to the party.
common_error.correct_alt: If I had time, I would go to the party.
common_error.explanation: A turanci, ba a yi amfani da 'would' a cikin wasu 'if' na wasu da yaushe ko wasu da yaushe. A turanci, a cikin wasu da yaushe muna yin amfani da 'would' a cikin wasu 'if', amma a turanci wasu da yaushe ba. Don yin wannan kuskure, kuna iya yin amfani da wasu na farko idan halin da ya dace ne, ko wasu na biyu idan halin da ba daidai ba ne.

levels.label: Type 1: Real and Possible Situations
levels.translation: Type 1: halaye masu daidaitawa da masu yiwuwa

examples.original: If it rains, we will cancel the picnic.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ɪt reɪnz wi wɪl ˈkænsəl ðə ˈpɪknɪk/
examples.translation: Idan ya yi, za mu sallama da wasu.
examples.note: Muna yin amfani da yanzu na simple da 'if' kuma 'will' a cikin wasu na wasu.

examples.original: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
examples.phonetic: /ənˈlɛs ju ˈhʌri ju wɪl mɪs ðə bʌs/
examples.translation: Ba ko ka tsaya, za ka yi mota da wasu.
examples.note: 'Unless' yana nufin 'ba ko' kuma ya hada da rashin, saboda haka ba a yi amfani da 'not' bayan.

examples.original: If we don't leave now, we'll be late.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wi doʊnt liːv naʊ wil bi leɪt/
examples.translation: Idan ba zan barin yanzu, za mu isar da yaushe.
examples.note: Tsarin 'we'll' don 'we will'. A cikin wasu 'if' muna yin amfani da yanzu da rashin.

examples.original: If I had a car, I would drive to work.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd ə kɑr aɪ wʊd draɪv tuː wɜrk/
examples.translation: Idan zan da mota, zan tafi aiki da mota.
examples.note: Yaushe na simple 'had' a cikin wasu 'if', duk da haka yana nufin yanzu ko wasu.

examples.original: If she were here, she would know what to do.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃi wɜr hɪr ʃi wʊd noʊ wʌt tuː duː/
examples.translation: Idan ta kasance a nan, ta san me za ta yi.
examples.note: Muna yin amfani da 'were' (ba 'was' ba) don dukan mutane a cikin tsarin da ya dace.

examples.original: If we won the match, we would be champions.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wi wʌn ðə mætʃ wi wʊd bi ˈtʃæmpiənz/
examples.translation: Idan mu ci nasara da wasu, za mu zama masu nasara.
examples.note: Yaushe na simple 'won' ba yana nufin lokaci da yaushe ba, amma wani halin da ba daidai ba ne.

examples.original: If I were you, I would apologize.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜr ju aɪ wʊd əˈpɑləˌdʒaɪz/
examples.translation: Idan na da kudi mai, zan tafi.
examples.note: Yin amfani da 'were' (ba 'was' ba) don dukan mutane a cikin tsarin da ya dace.

examples.original: If we had more time, we could visit the museum.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wi hæd mɔr taɪm wi kʊd ˈvɪzɪt ðə mjuˈziːəm/
examples.translation: Idan mu da lokaci mai, za mu iya ziyartar hoton.
examples.note: 'Could' a cikin wasu na wasu yana nufin yiwuwa ko iko.

examples.original: If they invited me, I might go to the party.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðeɪ ɪnˈvaɪtɪd mi aɪ maɪt goʊ tuː ðə ˈpɑrti/
examples.translation: Idan suka gayyata mini, ya zama wani wasu zan tafi wasu.
examples.note: 'Might' yana nufin yiwuwa mai yawa da 'would', kamar 'ya zama wani'.

title: Passive Voice: Present & Past / Yanzu da Kashewa
bridge: A Turanci, yanzu da kashewa yana da wata hanya da 'ser' + participio, kamar yadda a cikin Turanci (to be + past participle). Amma a Turanci, an fito da wata 'by' don bayyana wata abu mai amfani, while a Turanci muna 'por'. Kuma a Turanci, wata abu mai muhimmanci ne saboda yake da matsakaiciya da wata abu mai muhimmanci a Turanci, wanda yake da matsakaiciya da wata abu mai muhimmanci. Saboda wannan, a Turanci muna da matsakaiciya da wata abu mai muhimmanci. Saboda wannan, a Turanci muna da matsakaiciya da wata abu mai muhimmanci.
rule: Yanzu da kashewa yana da wata hanya da 'to be' a cikin lokaci mai dacewa (present simple: am/is/are; past simple: was/were) + wata participio mai dacewa da wata abu mai amfani. Wata abu mai amfani da wata abu mai amfani da wata abu mai amfani da wata abu mai amfani. Saboda wannan, a Turanci muna da matsakaiciya da wata abu mai amfani da wata abu mai amfani. Saboda wannan, a Turanci muna da matsakaiciya da wata abu mai amfani. Saboda wannan, a Turanci muna da matsakaiciya da wata abu mai amfani.
